integrity: Proof and reproducibility claims are self-reviewed; exhaustive finite prime-field computations are not infinite proofs. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform invertible structure matrices, fixed prime power q>=3, n>=2. The nonrigidity upper bound is not sharp; no statement covers singular matrices, all evolution algebras, or simultaneous field growth.
title: Generic automorphism rigidity and asymptotic orbit counts for perfect evolution algebras over fixed finite fields
